# Kodi Reader 0.3.1
Kodi Reader can now find and install updates from inside the app.
- Automatic daily update checks notify you when a new version is available. - Choose **Kodi Reader → Check for Updates…**, or use the button on the home screen. - The update window downloads, verifies, and installs the update, then relaunches Kodi Reader. - **Settings → Updates** lets you control automatic checks and optionally enable automatic downloading and installation. - Your books, notes, conversations, and reading progress stay on your Mac.
Updates and the update feed are signed. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
## Install this first update
Versions 0.3.0 and earlier do not include the updater. Download `KodiReader.dmg`, quit Kodi Reader, and drag the app into Applications, choosing Replace. This is the last manual install needed to enable future in-app updates.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later.
